storage: Keep in the fridge (about 4 °C) in its wrapper or a closed box; it can be frozen for longer storage. Keep a small amount at room temperature in a covered dish for a day or two if wanted for spreading.
looksLike: A pale yellow, soft block that spreads at room temperature; table butter sold in India (Amul and similar) is salted.
howToPick: Check the manufacturing date and a sealed pack, an even pale-yellow colour, and no sour or rancid smell. Avoid packs with oily leaks or dark patches (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
shelfLife: About several months refrigerated in an unopened pack; check the printed best-before date.
substitutes: Oil plus a little extra cream
Unsalted butter plus a pinch of salt

usedIn.raw: 15 g per serving (10 g inside, 5 g outside the bread)
